notes.title: Hotfix Update
notes.notes:
Hello, Soldiers!

Rolling out a hotfix today to address a few key issues and to add some improvements based on your feedback. Below are the details of what’s been fixed and enhanced:

Hotfixes & Improvements:

[b]Weapon Rotation Fixes[/b]
Corrected the weapon rotation issue caused by the introduction of realistic weight items. Weapons should now be properly aligned.

[b]Colored Markers for Attachments[/b]
Added colored markers for scopes, helping you better manage them in darker environments.

[b]Magazine Replacement Fix[/b]
Fixed a bug where magazines would disappear when swapped with another during reloads.

[b]Weapon Irons LOD Improvements[/b]
Improved the level of detail for weapon irons, ensuring they display correctly at various distances.

[b]Saved Scope & Sight Settings[/b]
Weapons configured in Headquarters will now retain their scope, zoom, and sight settings when entering missions.

[b]M203 Grenade Launcher Fix[/b]
Fixed the issue with the M203 grenade launcher, ensuring it opens and operates correctly when attached to rifles.

[b]Bullet Suppression Effects[/b]
A subtle bullet suppression effect has been added for the Player, increasing immersion during combat.

[b]Reduced Weapon Recoil[/b]
Weapon recoil has been slightly reduced to provide a more balanced shooting experience.

[b]Equalized Enemy Health[/b]
Enemies now have the same health across all difficulty levels. Previously, enemies had more health on higher difficulties.

[b]Grenade Backpack Fix[/b]
Fixed the issue where the Player's hand would disappear when placing grenades in the backpack.

[b]Ladder Climbing Fix[/b]
Improved ladder interactions, making climbing smoother and more responsive.

[b]Enhanced AI Behavior[/b]
The enemy and team AI have been improved. They now advance more cautiously, take cover under fire more often, and their walking animations have been enhanced for a more tactical experience.

Thank you all for your feedback and support. Your input continues to help refine Combat Troops VR. Stay sharp, and I hope these updates make your next mission even more enjoyable!

Salut!

notes.title: New Major Update Released Today!
notes.notes:
[h1]Hey everyone,[/h1]

I’m excited to let you know that the latest update has officially been released today! I sincerely apologize for the slight delay—things took a bit longer than expected as I worked to ensure everything was polished and up to the standard you deserve. Thank you so much for your patience and understanding during this time.

This update focuses heavily on enhancing the realism of weapon handling, improving item movement visualization, and ensuring smoother gameplay through extensive code optimizations. Below is a full list of what's been done:

[h2]🔧 Changes & Improvements:[/h2]

[b]Realistic Item Weight Perception:[/b]
Visual feedback on item weight has been added, reducing hand shake and improving aiming stability. Weapon smoothness has been optimized, eliminating all unintended jitters, while maintaining aiming speed when switching targets. This feature is scalable or can be disabled entirely (though not recommended).

[b]Weapon Enhancements:[/b]
Improved weapon holding (removing all hand desynchronization with the weapon).
Enhanced reloading mechanics for magazines, rockets, and shells (shotguns), with more interactive reloading processes.
Chambering improvements for all weapons.
A major update to eliminate hand "drift" while handling weapons.
Fixed gimbal lock when looking up or down.
Adjusted iron sight size for better aiming on most rifle weapons (some sights were too small, making aiming difficult).


[b]Weapon Attachments:[/b]
Optical scopes can now adjust zoom directly on the weapon by hovering the hand and using the trigger.
Reticle types for aperture sights can now be switched without removing the sight from the weapon.
Ghost Attachment Helper: A new helper system to assist with mounting attachments.


[b]Extensive Optimizations:[/b]
Significant improvements in performance, particularly for player and AI interactions, without visible changes to gameplay. (More optimizations are on the way!)

[b]New Damage Indicator:[/b]
Now displayed when health drops below 70%.

[b]Tactical GPS Improvements:[/b]
Enhanced objective icons and health bar.
Current objectives now highlighted with a red line while holding the GPS.

[b]Improved Item Grabbing Prioritization.[/b]

[b]Grenade Pull Pin Timer:[/b]
A visual icon has been added to the action, and pulling the pin from a grenade now requires half a second when using the mouth to remove the pin.

[b]Backpack Interaction Fixes:[/b]
Better hand synchronization when searching through the backpack while moving.

[b]Tutorial Map:[/b]
The tutorial map will now be skipped at the start if it has already been completed. (If it’s not skipping, simply delete the save file at: [[i]Your drive]\Users\[Your name]\AppData\Local\CombatTroopsVR\Saved\SaveGames\Settings.sav[/i]).

[b]Reduced Hand Movements for Team Commands:[/b]
Squad command hand movements have been minimized.

[b]Ammo Count Display:[/b]
Ammo count will now display when the magazine is pulled out.

[b]Increased Backpack Interaction Range:[/b]
Extended the distance for stowing items into the backpack icon.

[b]Post-Death Stats Panel:[/b]
Separated buttons for restarting the game and returning to headquarters after death.

[b]Explosive Object Highlighting:[/b]
Explosive objects will now be highlighted with a red line.

[b]Other Minor Fixes:[/b]
Various small improvements to overall gameplay.

I hope you enjoy the improvements, and I can’t wait to hear your feedback on the latest changes! Thank you again for your ongoing support!

notes.title: Update Announcement - Slight Delay and Exciting Improvements!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

I wanted to let you all know that the next update will be released with a slight delay. Originally, I planned to have it ready by mid-September, but I’ve pushed the release to the end of the month. As I got deeper into development, I found more ways to improve the game (as the saying goes – the appetite grows with eating), and I want to deliver the best experience possible.

Here’s what I’ve been working on and what you can expect in the upcoming update:

🔧 Changes & Improvements:
Weapon Weights: All weapons and items will now have weight, affecting movement and adding a more realistic feel to handling. This will also help reduce unnecessary weapon sway and improve aiming at long distances. You’ll be able to scale or disable this feature in the options menu if you prefer.

Reduced Hand Movements for Team Commands: I’ve minimized the hand movements required for issuing squad commands. (Voice commands are something I plan to introduce later down the line!)

Improved Weapon Chambering: You’ll now be able to hold the chambering action and reload without it automatically releasing once the reload is complete, giving you more control.

Reloading Enhancements: I’m adding haptic feedback for a more immersive reloading experience, and I’m also working on more realistic magazine interaction when inserting it into the weapon.

Other Small Changes: Separating the buttons for restarting the game and returning to headquarters when killed.

🔮 Possible Additions (Subject to progress):
Hand-Based Movement: I’m adding the option to switch movement so it no longer relies on the direction you're looking.

Enemy Fire Suppression Visibility: Both players and enemies will now experience bullet suppression effects when under fire. I may add additional behaviors to enemies in this situation.

Controller Mapping Options: I’m working on adding the ability to map controls similarly to other popular games, with options in the menu.

New Weapon - Light Machine Gun M249: I’m hoping to include the M249 LMG, but its release may depend on the final progress of other features.

💬 Have any suggestions or ideas for the features on this list?
Feel free to drop your thoughts while I’m still deep into development!

Thank you so much for your support and patience!

notes.title: Big Update Now Live!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! A substantial update has just been released, introducing a series of new features, enhancements, and much-needed bug fixes. Here’s what’s included in the latest rollout:

[b]Team Controls Update:[/b]
* The hand gesture controls for team management have been enhanced. Experience the new close walk formation among other tactical commands to elevate strategic gameplay.

[b]New Backpack System:[/b]
* A revamped backpack system allows for deeper interaction with inventory, including the ability to physically reach into backpack slots for a more immersive experience.
[url=https://youtu.be/Lr8a87UpTuQ]preview[/url]

[b]New Weapon Alert - Minigun:[/b]
* Anticipate the excitement in the next big update with the introduction of the Minigun, designed to elevate the firepower and excitement.
[url=https://youtu.be/9fV7eYdPXVs]preview[/url]

[b]Weapon Handling Enhancements:[/b]
* Adjustments have been made to weapon attachments. They now require more time to detach, minimizing accidental removals during reloads and ensuring a more realistic weapon handling experience.

[b]Crouch Mechanics Update:[/b]
* The crouch button has been updated to toggle between two modes, giving players greater control over maneuverability and stealth tactics.

[b]GPS Enhancement:[/b]
* The GPS device has been refined for easier use. It now activates with a simple glance, improving accessibility in the heat of action.

[b]Team Expansion:[/b]
* A new team member has been added, to support longevity and resilience during combat.

[b]Collapsible UI Enhancements:[/b]
* On the end stats screen, a new collapsible button enables continued observation of the team’s performance.

[b]Optimization and Bug Fixes:[/b]
* Continual work on squashing bugs and optimizing gameplay ensures smooth and high-quality performance, enhancing the visual experience without compromising the graphics.

[b]AI Enemy and Team Improvements:[/b]
* Significant enhancements in optimization, shooting, walking, and animation for both AI enemies and team members have been implemented, enhancing the realism and challenge of the game.

Thank you all for your invaluable feedback and contributions which significantly aid in the development of the game. Your insights are immensely appreciated and continue to drive improvements.

Salut!

notes.title: New Exciting Update for Combat Troops VR: Expanding the Battle Experience!
notes.notes:
Hello Community,

I hope this message finds you in good spirits, eager for some thrilling news! I am delighted to announce a significant update that is now live in the game. It introduces a variety of new features, improvements, and bug fixes, all aimed at enhancing your immersive combat experience.

Here's a comprehensive look at what's new:

[b]34 New Achievements:[/b] Dive into a new set of challenges with 34 additional achievements to unlock. Let's see who can collect them all first!

[b]Head-Bobbing Toggle:[/b] Understanding that VR can be intense for some players, I've added an option to turn off head-bobbing, ensuring a more comfortable VR experience for everyone.

[b]Improved Rifle Grabbing Animations: [/b]The animations for grabbing rifles' forearms and grips have been enhanced, providing a more lifelike handling experience.

[b]New Rail Mount for Rifles:[/b] A new rail mount has been introduced, making the attachment of a red dot sight with scope to your rifle more seamless than ever.

[b]Ragdoll Improvements: [/b]The ragdoll physics have been fine-tuned to add an extra layer of realism to your gameplay.

[b]No Return for Unpinned Grenades:[/b] Once you've pulled that pin and thrown the grenade, there's no going back! Unpinned grenades will no longer return to your inventory.

[b]Enhanced GPS Device:[/b] The GPS device on your forearm has been upgraded, providing improved navigation and usability.

[b]Bug Fixes: [/b]I've worked hard to address various bugs related to weapons and magazines, aiming to deliver a smoother gameplay experience.

[b]New Kill Stats:[/b] Keep track of your combat prowess with new statistics for different types of kills.

[b]Physics-Based Material Improvements for Supply Base Map: [/b]The material physics on the Supply Base map have been revamped for an even more immersive battlefield experience.

[b]C4 Reactive to Bullet Hits: [/b]Now, C4 explosives will detonate upon being hit by bullets, introducing a new tactical layer to your gameplay.

[b]Other Fixes and Enhancements:[/b] I've made numerous other improvements and fixes to provide the best VR combat experience possible.

I am deeply grateful for your continued support and feedback as I strive to make Combat Troops VR even better. Enjoy the new features, and I can't wait to see you on the battlefield!


Join our Discord community to become more involved in the development of the game. Share your experiences, ask questions, and provide feedback and suggestions directly to the development team. Your contributions are valuable to us as we continue to improve and grow the game.

https://discord.gg/YQNj4ja4fd


Best regards,

Robert
Combat Troops VR Developer
